> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **139** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `956cf302f2c8769ddb9b9fd2e8c4f90209e9d2dd` — the merge of head `b101db36c7c2f10dccaa3cad818599fc7ccfd9be` into base `ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 956cf302f2c8769ddb9b9fd2e8c4f90209e9d2dd && git checkout 956cf302f2c8769ddb9b9fd2e8c4f90209e9d2dd
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418 b101db36c7c2f10dccaa3cad818599fc7ccfd9be && git checkout -B drift-repro ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418 && git merge --no-ff b101db36c7c2f10dccaa3cad818599fc7ccfd9be

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs ee8751d41e61a18f7819e4d3ad2c340f51ab2418` → pass the list as

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b101db36c7c2f10dccaa3cad818599fc7ccfd9be`
Local-runs: none

Read at 2026-10-09T20:53Z: card #22472 (body, the claim `6086901040`, the dev report `6088349091`); objectui#12045 (body and ruling `6079807016`); PR #22532 (body, the 6-file list, the net diff of `b101db36c7` against its merge-base `9411faa1ba` on `main`, +251/-4); the 35 check-runs on the head: 35 completed, 33 `success`, 2 `skipped` (`Console Pin Gate`, whose `console` filter this diff does not match; `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`), 0 failed, 0 in progress. All seven required contexts read `success`: Lint and Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Core, Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL), Governed Surface Queue Guard. No governed path in the file list; 255 changed lines; head repo is the base repo; draft, auto-merge unarmed. Source read, never run: `origin/main` of this repo at `d303b3e7af`, and the sibling objectui checkout at the commit the row cites (`d03b022`) and at the pin (`f0268ad78`), through `git show` / `git cat-file` only.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **`PageComponentType` gains `record:approval_decision` (page.zod.ts) — RIGHT, and the right door.** The dev's reason cites the wrong rule for the right conclusion. The three-part evidence face (registration, publication, authorship) is the vocabulary's rule for `STRING_ARM_REGISTERED_TYPES` — row-LESS types in a reserved namespace, a ledger EMPTY since #21142. Row-only map entries (`record:line_items`, `element:metadata_viewer`, `element:definition-list`, the `object-*` blocks) enter under a different premise the same file states: "the measured string-arm registrations that DID get a row" — a renderer already registered and reachable through the open arm, its key set measured at the `.objectui-sha` pin (the #21142 row comment; the #20371 test header). `record:approval_decision` fails that premise, not the ledger's: nothing registers it (objectui `d03b022` pins `ComponentRegistry.has('record:approval_decision')` false, and the panel docblock says registration waits for this row), the file is absent at the pin `f0268ad78` (verified: `git cat-file -e` exits 128), and no author exists. A spec-first type therefore has only the enum door, and the card itself expects one ("the tables the enum's members must appear in"). The enum comment's wording should name the map's premise rather than the ledger's face; prose, not contract — not a block.
2. **`ComponentPropsMap['record:approval_decision'] = emptyProps('record:approval_decision')` (component.zod.ts) — RIGHT.** Read at objectui `d03b022` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`): `ApprovalDecisionRenderer` takes `{ schema: _schema, className, ...props }` and discards the node; `splitDesigner` reads only `data-obj-id`, `data-obj-type`, `style` (designer-injected, node-level); the panel reads `useRecordContext()` and `sys_approval_request`'s own declared actions at `record_section`. No authored key is read, so the accepted set is empty and `emptyProps(type)` is the spelling of its nine siblings. `className` inside `properties` is answered by `COMPONENT_NODE_KEYS_GUIDANCE` (`id`, `events`, `style`, `className`, `responsiveStyles`, `dataSource`, `responsive` belong on the NODE) — the spec's standing answer for every component, so the row introduces no new rule. The citation names repository and commit, which is a reading under the discipline; the pin cannot carry it (absent, verified), and `check:objectui-pin-citations` sits inside the green Lint and Repo Gates.
3. **`PRINT_REFUSED_PAGE_COMPONENT_TYPES` gains the member with its reason — RIGHT and complete.** `page-print.test.ts` pins every live KNOWN type as printable-or-refused exactly once and the reason as the clause after "it" with no full stop; the new reason ends "with nothing to print" and the pin is in the green Test Core. Tables that must list each member and do: `PageComponentType`, `ComponentPropsMap`, the print classification, the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/page.mdx` (two lines, `gen:docs`). Tables that derive and need no edit — RIGHT: `RESERVED_COMPONENT_TYPE_NAMESPACES` (unchanged, `record` was already claimed; the namespaces pin in `component-type-vocabulary.test.ts` still holds), `KNOWN_COMPONENT_TYPES` and `KNOWN_COMPONENT_TYPE_CANDIDATES` (+1 each; typo suggestions now offer the member), `RECORD_CONTEXT_BLOCK_TAGS` in `react-blocks.ts` (derived from the map's `record:` keys, so the react-page publish gate refuses `RecordApprovalDecision` with the generic prescription; `REACT_RECORD_BLOCK_ALTERNATIVES` is optional per type by its own docblock), the `record:*` prefix refusal in `validate-react-page-props.ts`, the lint print gate's `it.each`. Not member tables: `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` (rows only for field-binding props; this type has none), `scripts/format-type.test.ts` (static fixture), the `validate-component-props.ts` docblock, the sdui manifest (objectui's build at the pin), the v18 semantic migration entries (historical).
4. **Accept-set change at the authoring doors — RIGHT, pinned on both sides.** Before: `record:approval_decision` was `component-type-unknown` (error) — reserved namespace, undeclared. After: accepted; its bag is judged — absent or `{}` passes, any key is `component-props-unknown-key` (warning) at `properties.KEY` naming the component and the key, a node key inside `properties` gets the NODE prescription; `record:approval_decison` stays refused and now offers the declared spelling. Pinned in `packages/spec/src/ui/component-record-approval-decision-22472.test.ts` (row, node, page, vocabulary, print) and `packages/lint/src/validate-record-approval-decision-22472.test.ts` (the two rule ids, through `validateComponentTypes` / `validateComponentProps` and through `runAuthoringRules('validate', …)`). The ablation the report describes (row deleted, 5 of 8 spec pins red, the 3 survivors being the enum-only pins) is consistent with that split; the check-runs are the verdict here, not the local numbers.
5. **Public surface — RIGHT as a widening.** No export added or removed (`api-surface/` unchanged), no authorable key (`authorable-surface/` unchanged), `json-schema.manifest/` and the react-blocks contract unchanged — all read off the green `TypeScript Type Check` job, which runs every spec gate sequentially. `emptyProps` docblock count nine → ten; one `strictObject(` call site as before. Who derives from `PageComponentType.options`: in this repo, everything above plus `component.test.ts`'s safeParse loops and the Iso pin, all green. In objectui at `d03b022`, TWO consumers, not the one the dev named: `block-config.test.ts` (palette: every enum value offered or excluded with a reason) and `registry-inputs-spec-parity.test.ts` ("accounts for every spec-carried block — judged, propless, or ledgered", over `ComponentPropsMap` rows; its `isRetiredUpstream` reads the enum). Both fire the moment objectui resolves a spec carrying this member (objectui#12030, the switch to `next`); neither fires at the pin, which resolves `^17`, so the skipped Console Pin Gate hides no break. Acceptable: both tests exist to force a decision on a new member, and objectui#12045's page-mount step (Blocked-by this card and #12030) is where the registration, the zod arm, `known-schema-types.ts` and the palette decision land together — the panel's own docblock says so.
6. **Hand-written `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` not updated — ACCEPTED.** Its "Record context" list is introduced as "include", already omits `record:discussion` and `record:line_items`, has no gate, and sits outside the dispatched surface. A docs-only follow-up, not a rider.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/22472-spec-record-approval-decision.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, body `Clause-②: yes (widening)`. What the diff publishes is one new enum value, one `ComponentPropsMap` row and one print-refusal entry — additive on the published spec; nothing retired, renamed or narrowed, no 17.x author to migrate, so no ADR-0087 disposition marker is owed; `check:adr-0087-registration` and `check:changeset-no-major` are inside the green gates and `Check Changeset` is `success`. `main` is in pre mode `next`, so this lands on the 18.0.0-next line, as the ruling and the card read it (「17.x 不会发新版」). `minor` is the floor a `yes` owes and the right level — RIGHT.
- Only `@objectstack/spec` publishes: `packages/lint` gains a test file and no source; `content/docs` is not a package. No second changeset owed — RIGHT.
- `Clause-②:` line: the PR body carries `Clause-②: yes`, bare, at the start of its own line — the gate's one carrier, read as `yes`; the changeset carries `yes (widening)`. Both are well-formed; the arm adds direction, not a different value, and the gate reports the two as different declarations without requiring equality. Not a defect. Optional before landing: add `(widening)` to the body's line so the headline and the changeset grep to the same string.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations, each answered:
1. `PageComponentType` lives in `page.zod.ts`, not `component.zod.ts` — that file was on the dispatched surface already (the print tables). No breach.
2. New `packages/lint/src/validate-record-approval-decision-22472.test.ts` — the surface named `validate-component-props.ts` only if a row needed a hook; none did, and no lint source changed. A test alone, in the only package that can import the two rule ids H1 and H3 ask to pin. Accepted.
3. Attribution: the model-free trailer pair and the session-URL PR footer, per AGENTS.md over the harness reminder — verified on all three commits (`Co-authored-by: Claude`, `Claude-Session:`) and on the PR body. AGENTS.md governs; correct.
4. Stray `/suites.pid` (5 bytes, container root, outside every repo), left by a shell-scoping slip — ESCALATED to the maintainer: `rm /suites.pid` by hand. Nothing in any repo is affected.
5. Enum member plus row, beyond the card's text — answered in ① item 1: right conclusion, the rule it cites is the ledger's, the premise that decides is the map's.

`open_questions`: none declared; none found.

`out_of_scope_findings`, judged:
- A. `record:approvals` / `record:attachments` — objectui `d03b022` carries both (`plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts`, `app-shell/src/utils/pageSchemaIntrospect.ts`, cli `known-schema-types.ts`) inside the spec-reserved `record` namespace with no row and no member; the dev's H4 from the branch: `component-type-unknown` error, props never judged; no authored producer here. Honest, and correctly outside this diff — the card scoped it out itself. The disposition "noted, not filed" is ESCALATED: the finding has contract text (`component.zod.ts`'s #21142 row comment calls `record:line_items` "the last registered `record:*` renderer without a row", which these two falsify; the vocabulary's claim that the map covers the measured registrations) and a repro (H4), and Prime Directive #10 files a contract violation on its evidence. The adopting seat files ONE unassigned finding card naming both types, with the report's dedupe words; the remedy (a measured row each, or objectui renaming out of the namespace) is graded there. Not a block on this PR.
- B. Placement unchecked — `record:approval_decision` on any other object's record page parses, validates clean, and objectui draws nothing (the renderer returns null unless the record context's object is `sys_approval_request`). That is the metadata-authoring-trap shape in #10's own words — an authored block silently dropped, the very failure the ruling cited to justify the row — and "no producer yet" is a reach argument #10 does not admit. ESCALATED: the adopting seat files it as an unassigned `domain:spec` finding (a lint rule binding the type to the page's `object`, with #22473 as its first producer; `validate-page-field-bindings.ts` is the precedent for object-aware component checks). The diff states the constraint in the row comment and the changeset, so the claim is as narrow as the enforcement; the declaration is not at fault and this PR is not blocked.

Found by this review, not flagged by the dev:
- C. The PR body says the contract decisions were "relayed to objectui#12045"; the report's `api_writes` lists three writes, none on objectui. The name stayed as proposed, so the card requires no comment there, but the two objectui consequences in ① item 5 are owed to objectui#12045's page-mount step. ESCALATED to the adopting seat: one comment on objectui#12045 at adoption, naming both tests.
- D. ① item 6: the hand-written pages doc omits the member. Noted; docs-only follow-up.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-22472-approval-decision-component`
Reviewed-by: `session_01VZqqwTj2wsihZEbfT6yyYN`

**VERDICT: PASS**
